subject: Graduate Civil Engineer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello BenchHDC team,

I'm applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in Port Adelaide that I saw on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, plus cost estimates and bills of quantities. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections and quality checks, tracking materials and procurement and writing progress reports.

Your advert describes a new role mixing project coordination, tendering and estimating, quality documentation and site inspections on underground infrastructure, which is the broad start I'm looking for. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide. I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked on directional drilling yet, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in Port Adelaide advertised on SEEK. A newly created position that covers project coordination, tendering and estimating, quality documentation and site inspections is the broad, hands-on start I want for my civil career.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date.

I hold an Australian driver's licence and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide. I have not yet worked on directional drilling or Australian underground infrastructure projects, so I would start at graduate level and learn quickly from your drilling manager and crews.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
